<thought>To successfully add the CO₂ molecule, both the slab and adsorbate CIF strings must include a complete atom site loop with occupancy values. I will construct a minimal valid slab CIF (including occupancy) and use the original CO₂ CIF (which already has the required loops). Then I will call add_adsorbate_to_slab_text with a height of 2.0 Å and no specific site. After obtaining the combined CIF, I will write it to a file and return its path.</thought>
